lastCompletedStory.title: In-progress-work conflict gate at plan start

nextStoryContext: US-005 (orchestrator boot surfaces active gate as opening blocker line) is doc-only and does NOT depend on US-004's registered gate kind -- it just needs .claude/.cam-gate.json's SHAPE (gate/options/context/decision, src/supervisor/gate.ts's CamGate) to write the boot-read entry in templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md AND .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (GOTCHA already in its notes: cam-dual-copy-is-per-file, edit BOTH then embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check). Separately, for anyone touching the in-progress-conflict gate later: the detection lives in src/supervisor/in-progress-conflict.ts (detectInProgressConflict/hasIncompletePrd/isCamFeatureBranch/buildInProgressConflictContext/readHeadBranchName/makeInProgressConflictResolver), wired at the literal top of runPlanPhase (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) via two new optional RunPlanPhaseOptions seams: detectInProgressConflictFn (returns a context string or null) and writeInProgressConflictGateFn (called with that context, calls writeGateAndNotify). CRITICAL GOTCHA if you ever touch the BLOCK->re-plan loop (runPlanPhaseWithReplan, CAM-204): both new seams are explicitly set to `undefined` on every re-plan round (round >= 2) -- round 1's own freshly-planned, not-yet-approved prd.json is all passes:false by construction, so re-running the detection on round 2+ would misdetect that SAME cycle's in-flight draft as someone else's in-progress work and wrongly pause mid-replan. Do not remove that omission without re-deriving the guard some other way. runPostAuditAction/exitPhaseAfterPlan both special-case the 'in-progress-conflict' planResult/PostAuditActionResult kind as a pure no-op (mirrors 'branch-created'): the gate write already flipped phase to 'awaiting-operator' before runPlanPhase ever returned that kind, so touching phase again downstream would clobber it. The resolution handler (continue->implementing, ship->shipping, abandon->rm handoff.json+rm prd.json+git checkout main then planning) is registered into makeProductionGatePhaseFn's registry in sidecar.ts via a separate makeInProgressConflictResolverDeps factory (kept OUT of makeProductionGatePhaseFn's own body on purpose: test/sidecar-gate-phase.test.ts's US-003 source-text oracle only slices the first 800 chars after the function signature, and inlining the registry construction pushed the pollAndResolveGate(...) call outside that window during this story).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring: node:fs/node:child_process builtins, existing gate.ts primitive (US-003), decide.ts's PrdSnapshot partition, git symbolic-ref/checkout via the existing SpawnFn seam. No new external dependency introduced.
